text:
jonathan: Quick sync — need a PIR for incident RWINF-621 (EU latency spike + 502s). Looking for a facilitator and best time for folks.

maria: Tues morning PST works for me (before 11am). Prefer a shorter 45m slot.

sam_ops: I can step in as facilitator if no one else volunteers. Can we get the pre-read by EOD today?

devex-lia: happy to facilitate as well — I ran the initial runbook during the incident and can prep the timeline.

elena: product + CS need to be present for customer impact review. @maria can you share impacted accounts list?

maria: will drop the list in the doc. brief note: 3 paying customers saw delayed responses, no data loss.

sre-bot: Incident summary: RWINF-621 | 2026-03-10 09:12 UTC start | 09:38 UTC mitigated. Root symptom: autoscaler misrouting to drained pods. Affected services: inference-gateway-eu. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/RWINF-621

jonathan: Draft agenda:
```
1) Incident recap & timeline (10m)
2) Customer impact & comms review (10m)
3) Root cause & mitigation walkthrough (10m)
4) Action items & owners (10m)
5) Follow-ups + rollout plan (5m)
```

jonathan: Proposed slots (45m):
- Tue 2026-03-12 08:00 PST / 16:00 CET
- Tue 2026-03-12 10:30 PST / 18:30 CET
- Wed 2026-03-13 09:00 PST / 17:00 CET

devex-lia: prefer the first slot (08:00 PST) — earlier is better for EU folks.

sam_ops: second works for me.

elena: first slot is hard for CS, second is better.

jonathan: Ok — looks like second slot has overlap. @devex-lia are you okay to swap to second if needed?

devex-lia: yes I can move to second if sam_ops is facilitating.

jonathan: cool. Action items before PIR:
- devex-lia: prepare timeline + logs snippets
- maria: customer impact list + comms draft
- sam_ops: mitigation steps and proposed guardrails
- jonathan: create meeting invite + notes doc

maria: I'll post the customer list in the doc by EOD.

incident-bot: Reminder: add the PIR tag and set priority = P2 in calendar invite.

jonathan: I'll send the Doodle if anyone else can't make those slots. If no objections I'll book Tue 10:30 PST in 4 hours.

maria: :thumbsup:

sam_ops: leaning :+1: — will be ready.

devex-lia: thanks everyone, will upload timeline and pre-read link in thread when done.
